eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Arrest sealing after successful completion of a superior court drug diversion programme under Cal. Penal Code § 851.90, where the judge may order the arrest records sealed as described in § 851.92 on written or oral motion of any party or on the court's own motion with notice to all parties
eligibilityData.waitingPeriodText: After successful completion of the diversion or deferred entry of judgment programme — duration: none stated
additionalFacts: There is no statewide Judicial Council form for this route; the county publishes its own petition and order, and the participant must ask the county clerk or self-help centre which local form applies to a section 851.90 sealing.

On issuing the order the court gives a copy to the person and the prosecuting attorney; within 30 days the court forwards the order to the arresting agency and other participating agencies; local records are marked "arrest sealed" and state records are marked "arrest relief granted."
Proof of programme completion is obtained by the participant from the superior court that handled the case or from the diversion programme provider; LegalEase does not obtain, receive or inspect it.
